DC_DESCRIPTOR_GET_VENDOR(3) Library Functions Manual DC_DESCRIPTOR_GET_VENDOR(3)

NAME

dc_descriptor_get_vendor — get the vendor of a dive computer descriptor

LIBRARY

library “libdivecomputer”

SYNOPSIS

#include <libdivecomputer/descriptor.h>

const char *
dc_descriptor_get_vendor(const dc_descriptor_t *descriptor);

DESCRIPTION

Gets the vendor (e.g., “Suunto”) of a dive computer descriptor or NULL if none was declared.

RETURN VALUES

This returns the nil-terminated vendor string or NULL if none exists.

The returned pointer is not valid after the descriptor has been freed.

SEE ALSO

dc_descriptor_get_product(3)
